name: DNSBL
description: Deny access based on external DNSBL servers.

DNSBL_IGNORE_IP.help: List of IP/network, separated with spaces, to ignore for DNSBL checks.
DNSBL_IGNORE_IP.label: DNSBL ignore IP/network

DNSBL_IGNORE_HEADER_NAME.help: Name of a request header that exempts the request from the DNSBL checks. Any client can send this header : treat it as a shared secret, only over HTTPS.
DNSBL_IGNORE_HEADER_NAME.label: Ignored header name

DNSBL_IGNORE_HEADER_VALUE.help: Value (PCRE regex) the header must match to exempt the request from the DNSBL checks. Leave empty to match on the header being present. Anchor it with ^ and $ : the match is not anchored by default.
DNSBL_IGNORE_HEADER_VALUE.label: Ignored header value

DNSBL_IGNORE_IP_URLS.help: List of URLs, separated with spaces, containing IP/network to ignore for DNSBL checks. Also supports file:// URLs and auth basic using http://user:pass@url scheme.
DNSBL_IGNORE_IP_URLS.label: DNSBL ignore IP/network URLs
